# Documents

Everything Whity Render prints: invoices, letters, payslips, reports. Documents carry the **tenant's** brand, print cleanly in black and white, and read in either language. The rules are decisions 6.1–6.8; the 13 templates were built from them in stage 8.

![The 13 document templates for Example Bakery](data:image/png;base64,)

## The page

| | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| Paper | A4 by default; A5 and US Letter follow the same rules. 80 mm thermal receipts come later |
| Margins | 16 mm on every side (178 mm of content on A4) |
| Letterhead | The tenant's logo, address and tax number at the start side; the title, number and date at the end side |
| Colour | The tenant colour on the **title only**; everything else is ink, so documents fax and photocopy cleanly. `--doc-accent` is the tenant's print colour, the same in light and dark mode |
| Languages | Either language leads, per customer: Arabic with small English labels (the layout mirrors) or English with small Arabic labels. Latin values inside Arabic are isolated |

## Inside

| | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| Type | Body Noto Sans 9.5 pt, labels 8.5 pt, the title Readex Pro 600 at 22 pt, codes in Geist Mono |
| Line items | A strong rule under the header, hairlines between rows; no zebra stripes, no grid |
| Numbers | Tabular figures, end-aligned, JOD to 3 decimals |
| Totals | An end-aligned block 46% wide; only the grand total is bold, with a 1.5 pt rule above. The amount is written in words under it, in both languages (dinars and fils) |
| Footer | The JoFotara stamp, reference and "Page x of y" at the start side; the QR code at the end side |
| Continuation | A small running header (logo, number, "continued"), the table header repeated, "Brought forward" and "Carried forward", totals on the last page only |
| Charts | Grey bars with the one that matters in ink, values on the bars, no legend |
| Agents | A document an agent made or sent says so in its footer, with the person it acted for |

## The set

| Group | Documents | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Sales | Quote · Tax invoice · Credit note · Receipt (A5) | Fiscal documents (invoice, credit note) carry the JoFotara stamp and QR; the quote's QR opens it online to accept |
| Accounts | Statement of account · Payment reminder · Delivery note | The statement has a running balance and ageing; the delivery note has no prices |
| People | Payslip · Employment letter · Leave approval | QR to verify; the employment letter keeps a signature and stamp row; the leave approval shows its trail from the audit log |
| General | Report · Letter · Purchase order | Reports run to several pages with key numbers and an ink-only chart |

The examples tell one story for Example Bakery: quote QUO-0318 → invoice INV-1042 (JOD 301.600) → credit note CN-0012 (JOD 98.600) → receipt RCT-0207 (JOD 203.000) → the clinic's October statement.

## Building one

`Doc` lays out pages with a line table, totals and words; `DocPages` gives letters and reports the same letterhead and foot; `DocTable`, `DocKpis`, `DocBars`, `DocNote`, `DocSign` and `DocAmount` are the parts; `Whity.amountInWords(amount, 'en' | 'ar')` writes JOD in words; `DocPreview` shows a document in the app. Every standard label is in `Whity.docLabels` in both languages.

## Before shipping

- Have an Arabic-speaking accountant review the Arabic amount in words.
- Confirm the required invoice and credit note fields against the JoFotara specification. Every legal field comes from tenant settings.
- Whity Render should measure row heights when it paginates; the row counts in `Doc` are a safe default.
